headline: Zapier: Connect your apps, automate tasks
body: Set up Zaps to connect your favorite apps and let them do the work. For instance, automatically save new email attachments to a cloud storage folder.
caption:
Tired of manual copy-pasting between apps? Zapier helps you connect thousands of online tools so they can share information and trigger actions automatically. This means less time on repetitive tasks and more time on what you do best. It's like having a digital assistant! Check out their free plan to see how many Zaps and tasks you can automate each month.
